WITH site_totals AS (
  SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    zoneref,
    feature_count,
    CAST(feature_count AS REAL) / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM site_totals
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  s.zoneref AS site_code,
  s.feature_count,
  s.share,
  s.share - a.avg_share AS margin_above_average
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
